info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Investment Portfolio Dividends-v5-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Dividends API provides users with access to detailed information about dividends related to their investment portfolios. This endpoint enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of dividends associated with their holdings, helping them monitor revenue generated from investments. Typically utilized by financial analysts and portfolio managers, this API supports strategic decision-making and effective investment tracking. By leveraging this API, users can gain valuable insights into dividend performance and trends across their portfolios.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the dividend information associated with a specific financial portfolio. The data includes details about the dividends earned on the investments within the portfolio, helping users track their returns and make informed investment decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the dividend information associated with the specified portfolio. Ensure that the request follows the schema provided.
